{"dialogue": "Jen: ugh morning
Jen: still in pajamas lol
Me: same, i just made toast
Alex: morning, i need coffee asap
Jen: same, kettle is on
Me: did you end up trying that oven trick?
Jen: for the bananas? not yet
Jen: they are still so green
Alex: give it another day, theyll turn
Me: lol mine always go from green to brown overnight
Jen: literally, no in between
Alex: did you guys sleep okay? i was up late
Me: yeah i crashed early
Jen: jealous, i stayed up watching that show
Alex: oh the lighthouse one?
Jen: yeah im finally on episode 5
Me: no spoilers then
Jen: i wont, its getting good though
Alex: im still behind, gonna catch up tonight
Me: same, i need something to watch while i fold laundry
Jen: ugh laundry, dont remind me
Alex: lol i have a mountain too
Me: what are you guys having for lunch today?
Jen: probably leftovers again
Alex: i have that frozen pizza still lol
Me: no shame, pizza is pizza
Jen: true, cereal for lunch again would be elite too
Alex: you and your cereal
Me: hey its fast
Jen: okay so quick thing
Jen: i cant make it friday
Jen: im so sorry, stuff came up with my sister
Me: oh no is everything okay?
Jen: yeah just timing stuff, she gets in tomorrow night and i need to shift things around
Alex: ah gotcha, family first
Jen: i feel bad bailing, i know we were all looking forward to it
Me: dont worry about it, its fine
Alex: yeah seriously dont stress
Jen: still annoyed, this week is chaos
Me: tell me about it, my morning is already chaos
Alex: same, inbox is a mess
Jen: ugh, did your dentist thing go okay btw?
Me: yeah it was fine, quick thank god
Alex: nice, no lecture?
Me: lol a little lecture but survived
Jen: they always do that
Alex: floss more!!
Me: exactly that
Jen: okay but yeah friday is a no for me
Alex: honestly me too, let's just do this another day
Alex: this week got weird on my end too
Me: yeah lets just postpone then
Me: no worries at all
Jen: thank you guys, raincheck?
Alex: absolutely, raincheck for sure
Me: 100%, we can figure it out later
Jen: perfect, i feel less guilty now
Alex: you should, zero guilt
Me: did you still want that soup? i remember you had extra
Jen: oh yeah! i still have some
Jen: i can save you some for later
Me: ooh yes please if you still have it
Alex: jealous again, i want soup
Jen: lol i only made a little batch
Me: what are you making tonight then?
Jen: probably just pasta again
Alex: classic
Me: easy is good midweek
Alex: i might still do thai tonight
Jen: ooh get the pad thai
Me: yes teleport some to me
Alex: if i could i would lol
Jen: okay i need to actually get dressed
Me: same, still in sweats
Alex: im still on coffee number one, need number two
Jen: go get it, its a two-coffee morning
Me: facts
Alex: brb, kettle or whatever
Jen: lol okay
Me: im gonna start laundry so i stop dreading it", "writer_note": "Kept the Friday cancellation vague without naming the activity or location, buried it in normal morning chatter about food, laundry and the show to match their established voices and hit the required beats."}
